PIXIE Alignment Note: Bryan Ogden / bryanogden.com

Date: 2026-09-21 Status: Observation only. No relationship established.

Observation

Bryan Ogden's stated AI consulting thesis, as published at bryanogden.com, describes trustworthy AI deployment as privacy-first, human-in-the-loop, and bounded by respect for system limits.

PIXIE's behavioral boundary in the 50 Ways architecture is: OBSERVE -> UNDERSTAND -> SUGGEST. PIXIE does not act without human confirmation.

These two framings describe compatible principles. They were arrived at independently.

What this note does not establish

This note records a philosophical similarity between two independently developed positions. It does not attribute the OBSERVE -> UNDERSTAND -> SUGGEST principle to Bryan Ogden. It does not imply endorsement, collaboration, or shared authorship. If a formal relationship develops, this note should be updated to reflect the actual terms of that relationship.
